csv_scope_of_work: This Request for Proposals ( RFP ) is issued by the City of Cleveland Heights, Ohio (the City ) to solicit proposals from interested parties ( Proposers ) for the purchase and development of certain City-owned vacant residential lots (each, a Property, and collectively, the Properties ) for the construction of new, code-compliant, owner-occupied single-family residences. This RFP is a solicitation for proposals from Proposers that intend to develop and occupy the residence upon construction, or will have a family member occupy the residence upon construction
